result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: a low-contrast promotional banner and bottom content that is partially obscured by the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The promotional banner text is very low contrast against the pale green background, making the offer details hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text or use a stronger banner background so the headline and subtext meet contrast guidelines and remain readable.

issues.description: The next restaurant card at the bottom is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, so part of the content is hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add extra bottom padding/inset to the scroll area so list items can sit fully above the tab bar.
